messages:
Samir Patel (CS Lead): starting Aurelia Health onboarding kickoff thread. want to lock stakeholders, success metrics, timeline, and call out any renewal/legal risk. proposing 20m sync today at 3pm PT.
Olivia Park (AE): booked. quick note: customer asked for HIPAA BA amendment; legal review ~7bd likely. potential PO delay = renewal risk. :hourglass: 
Dr. Mei Chen (Clinical Dir): clinical goals: cut chart lookup time for nurses by ~30%, validate alert precision. I can recruit 3 pilot nurses.
Jordan Lee (Integration Eng): tech needs: SFTP for batch exports, FHIR read access, sandbox de-id dataset. estimate 3 dev days after creds. prefer API key/service account for sandbox.
Priya Rao (Legal): upload redlines and I'll triage. can fast-track (48h) if AE confirms PO progressing. flag: data residency clause might need exec sign-off.
Maya Singh (Enablement): will run 45m admin + 60m hands-on for nurses. can draft short feedback survey (Likert + 1 free text).
Samir Patel (CS Lead): proposed success criteria (owners): - BA amendment + PO signed (Olivia) - EHR batch export validated to Redwood ingest (Jordan) - 3 nurses complete triage workflow w/ >=90% satisfaction (Dr. Chen) - zero P0 incidents during pilot (Samir)
Olivia Park (AE): I'll chase procurement. if PO delayed >8bd we switch to limited synthetic-data pilot to maintain momentum.
Jordan Lee (Integration Eng): action: I'll prepare validation scripts and sandbox infra once AE shares creds.
Maya Singh (Enablement): drafting survey now, will post within 4h.
Samir Patel (CS Lead): timeline draft: Week0: kickoff + legal check; Week1: sandbox + basic export validation; Week2: clinician pilot + enablement; Week3: ops workshop + feedback; Week4: pilot review + contract finalization.
Priya Rao (Legal): please attach customer's redlines here. I'll respond with questions within 48h.
Samir Patel (CS Lead): thanks all. recap owners: Olivia -> procurement; Jordan -> sandbox & validation; Dr. Chen -> clinician slots & feedback; Maya -> survey & enablement; Priya -> legal review; Samir -> SLOs and incident playbook. Drop blockers here before the 3pm sync. :white_check_mark:
